title: OpenConnect Pulse support incomplete
line: OpenConnect VPN settings now have a "Disable UDP (DTLS and ESP)" checkbox, needed by many Pulse Connect Secure gateways.
explanation: NetworkManager-openconnect supports a disable_udp key that makes openconnect skip DTLS/ESP, which many Pulse Connect Secure gateways need, but plasma-nm's openconnect editor had no control for it, so users had to set it with nmcli. GNOME's editor has this checkbox. The change adds a "Disable UDP (DTLS and ESP)" checkbox to the General box of the VPN (openconnect) tab that loads and saves disable_udp (yes/no).

commits.message:
openconnect: add an option to disable UDP

The editor had no way to set disable_udp, which many Pulse Connect Secure
gateways need, so users had to edit the connection by hand. Add a "Disable
UDP (DTLS and ESP)" checkbox that reads and writes that key, as GNOME does.

BUG: 492868

patches.diff:
From 9f2b27019a00f18e91ac0609928d329d598a5724 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:01:32 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] openconnect: add an option to disable UDP

The editor had no way to set disable_udp, which many Pulse Connect Secure
gateways need, so users had to edit the connection by hand. Add a "Disable
UDP (DTLS and ESP)" checkbox that reads and writes that key, as GNOME does.

BUG: 492868
---
 vpn/openconnect/nm-openconnect-service.h | 1 +
 vpn/openconnect/openconnectprop.ui       | 7 +++++++
 vpn/openconnect/openconnectwidget.cpp    | 2 ++
 3 files changed, 10 insertions(+)

diff --git a/vpn/openconnect/nm-openconnect-service.h b/vpn/openconnect/nm-openconnect-service.h
index 407cf6c0a..f43a9f00f 100644
--- a/vpn/openconnect/nm-openconnect-service.h
+++ b/vpn/openconnect/nm-openconnect-service.h
@@ -39,6 +39,7 @@
 #define NM_OPENCONNECT_KEY_MCACERT "mcacert"
 #define NM_OPENCONNECT_KEY_MCAKEY "mcakey"
 #define NM_OPENCONNECT_KEY_MCA_PASS "mca_key_pass"
+#define NM_OPENCONNECT_KEY_DISABLE_UDP "disable_udp"
 
 #define NM_OPENCONNECT_USER "nm-openconnect"
 
diff --git a/vpn/openconnect/openconnectprop.ui b/vpn/openconnect/openconnectprop.ui
index 0747cada9..1a7118120 100644
--- a/vpn/openconnect/openconnectprop.ui
+++ b/vpn/openconnect/openconnectprop.ui
@@ -110,6 +110,13 @@
       <item row="8" column="1">
        <widget class="KUrlRequester" name="leCsdWrapperScript"/>
       </item>
+      <item row="9" column="0" colspan="2">
+       <widget class="QCheckBox" name="chkDisableUdp">
+        <property name="text">
+         <string>Disable UDP (DTLS and ESP)</string>
+        </property>
+       </widget>
+      </item>
       <item row="0" column="0">
        <widget class="QLabel" name="label_7">
         <property name="text">
diff --git a/vpn/openconnect/openconnectwidget.cpp b/vpn/openconnect/openconnectwidget.cpp
index b2ca097f2..1b2c750d6 100644
--- a/vpn/openconnect/openconnectwidget.cpp
+++ b/vpn/openconnect/openconnectwidget.cpp
@@ -234,6 +234,7 @@ void OpenconnectSettingWidget::loadConfig(const NetworkManager::Setting::Ptr &se
     d->ui.cmbReportedOs->setCurrentIndex(cmbReportedOsIndex);
     d->ui.chkAllowTrojan->setChecked(dataMap[NM_OPENCONNECT_KEY_CSD_ENABLE] == "yes");
     d->ui.leCsdWrapperScript->setUrl(QUrl::fromLocalFile(dataMap[NM_OPENCONNECT_KEY_CSD_WRAPPER]));
+    d->ui.chkDisableUdp->setChecked(dataMap[NM_OPENCONNECT_KEY_DISABLE_UDP] == "yes");
     d->ui.leMcaCert->setUrl(QUrl::fromLocalFile(dataMap[NM_OPENCONNECT_KEY_MCACERT]));
     d->ui.leMcaPrivateKey->setUrl(QUrl::fromLocalFile(dataMap[NM_OPENCONNECT_KEY_MCAKEY]));
     d->ui.leUserCert->setUrl(QUrl::fromLocalFile(dataMap[NM_OPENCONNECT_KEY_USERCERT]));
@@ -357,6 +358,7 @@ QVariantMap OpenconnectSettingWidget::setting() const
     if (d->ui.leCsdWrapperScript->url().isValid()) {
         data.insert(QLatin1String(NM_OPENCONNECT_KEY_CSD_WRAPPER), d->ui.leCsdWrapperScript->url().toLocalFile());
     }
+    data.insert(QLatin1String(NM_OPENCONNECT_KEY_DISABLE_UDP), d->ui.chkDisableUdp->isChecked() ? "yes" : "no");
     if (d->ui.leMcaCert->url().isValid()) {
         data.insert(QLatin1String(NM_OPENCONNECT_KEY_MCACERT), d->ui.leMcaCert->url().toLocalFile());
     }
--

With the fix: "Disable UDP (DTLS and ESP)" checkbox, here ticked after saving and reopening

review.text: The new "Disable UDP (DTLS and ESP)" checkbox in vpn/openconnect cleanly loads and saves disable_udp (yes/no) matching NetworkManager-openconnect. However, this only fixes half of bug 492868 while still tagging BUG: 492868; the second reported issue—Pulse Connect Secure authentication dialogs missing gateway/username/password/TOTP input fields so users still cannot connect from the GUI—is left completely unfixed.
changes: Fix the second half of bug 492868 in plasma-nm/vpn/openconnect (openconnectauth.cpp / openconnectauthworkerthread.cpp) so Pulse Connect Secure username, password, and TOTP prompts are properly shown and functional in the authentication dialog.

reviews.text: The new "Disable UDP (DTLS and ESP)" checkbox in vpn/openconnect cleanly loads and saves disable_udp (yes/no) matching NetworkManager-openconnect. However, this only fixes half of bug 492868 while still tagging BUG: 492868; the second reported issue—Pulse Connect Secure authentication dialogs missing gateway/username/password/TOTP input fields so users still cannot connect from the GUI—is left completely unfixed.
changes: Fix the second half of bug 492868 in plasma-nm/vpn/openconnect (openconnectauth.cpp / openconnectauthworkerthread.cpp) so Pulse Connect Secure username, password, and TOTP prompts are properly shown and functional in the authentication dialog.

reviews.text: The Disable UDP checkbox itself is clean and correct: it loads/saves NetworkManager-openconnect's disable_udp key as yes/no like the neighbouring CSD checkbox, sits in the right repo (plasma-nm vpn/openconnect), and the before/after screenshots plus the GetSettings round-trip prove it. But the report has two parts and the second one (the auth dialog for Pulse shows a credentials prompt for server 'https:' with no input fields, or fails with no credentials, instead of asking for username, password and TOTP) is untouched, as the notes admit, while the commit says BUG: 492868. Closing the bug with this commit would leave the reporter's main connection failure open.
changes: Use CCBUG: 492868 for this checkbox commit (it can land as-is that way), or add a second commit that fixes the Pulse username/password/TOTP prompt flow in openconnectauth.cpp and keep BUG: 492868 on that one.
If the prompt part is fixed, verify it against a real or simulated Pulse (IF-T/TLS + EAP-TTLS) gateway showing the username, password and token forms in the Plasma auth dialog.
